name: specter-osint
description: SpecterOSINT - Forensic Intelligence Platform (Electron desktop + Python engine)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace desktop
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff check engine/ tests/ && node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff format --check engine/ tests/
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:py && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop
